title: The coffee counter at six
logline: The coffee counter across from the seawall at six in the morning in vol 7's summer: chairs up, one down, an old woman's coat on it, a crow on the railing outside. The page doesn't know the woman's name and draws her seat as hers anyway.

panels.composition: A small coffee shop's interior at six in the morning seen from the door, chairs up on tables but one down with an old woman's coat over it, a crow on the railing outside the window.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small coffee shop's interior at six in the morning seen from the door with chairs up on the tables but one chair down with an old woman's coat over it, a crow on the railing outside the window, no people, no words legible
image.notes: Vol 7: Mrs. Gable's morning seat at the Daily Grind; the crow. The page never names her.
